title_en: Supplementary Provisions of the State Council on the Retirement of Senior Experts

articles.content_en:
To facilitate the implementation of the professional and technical position appointment system nationwide, the following supplementary provisions are hereby made to the "Provisional Provisions of the State Council on Certain Issues Concerning the Retirement of Senior Experts" issued by the State Council on September 12, 1983:
All senior scientists, senior professors, and senior experts (including those who worked abroad before the founding of the People's Republic of China and returned after the founding) who engaged in professional and technical work before the founding of the People's Republic of China, had reached the age of 60 by 1986, and had obtained a title equivalent to associate professor or above before September 1, 1983, may retain the title they have already obtained after their retirement, and their retirement pension shall be paid at 100% of their original salary. Those who have already gone through the retirement procedures and meet the above conditions shall be treated likewise; the time for receiving the retirement pension at 100% of the original salary shall be calculated from February 1986.
The phrase "obtained a title equivalent to associate professor or above before September 1, 1983" as used herein refers to the scope provided in Article 1 of the "Provisional Provisions of the State Council on Certain Issues Concerning the Retirement of Senior Experts" and includes those who had been evaluated by the professional title evaluation organization as having the title of associate professor or above before September 1, 1983, and whose titles had been submitted to the relevant department for "pending approval" or "pending conferral."
